verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová: Ayik schaanel yich yopisio winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a sacerdoteal t'ayin, haton juntzanh tik tza b'o yuj heb': Tzik'kot junok nok' kelem wakax yet' chawanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel malaj jab'ok spaltail.
Yet' ixim harina yik trigo te wach', malaj yich sb'at t'a skal, haton t'a ixim tzak' b'ojok ixim pan yet' k'oxox pan kalab'il yet' aceite yet' pax k'oxox pan jay sb'onhchajoch aceite t'ay.
Slajwi chi' tz'em ixim t'a yol junok yune' mooch, tzik'anb'at t'a in kajnub' yet' nok' kelem wakax yet' pax chawanh nok' ch'ak kalnel chi'.
Slajwi chi', tzik'anb'at winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a. Hata' sb'ikel sb'a heb'.

Slajwi chi', tzik'anpaxb'at k'apak pichul yik sacerdoteal. Tzak'anoch k'apak t'a winhaj Aarón chi', haton k'apak pichul yelxo wal te jukan yet' junxo k'apak jukan, k'apak chaleka yet' k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ool, tzak'anoch stzek'ul snanhal jun chaleka chi'.
Slajwi chi', tza b'ak'anoch sk'ox winh t'a sjolom. Ha t'a snanhal sat sk'ox winh chi' tzak'och jun oro jay lechinak, haton sch'oxan yechel to wik yaj winh.
Slajwi chi' tzik'ankot aceite sk'anchaji ayik sik'chajel junok mach tz'ochkan wikok. Tzak'ank'e t'a sjolom winhaj Aarón chi' yik tz'ochkan winh sacerdoteal.
Slajwi chi', sjapax heb' yuninal winh chi' t'a a tz'ey, tzak'anoch spichul heb' jukan.
Tza b'oanoch stzek'ul winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, tza b'oank'e sk'ox heb'. Ichaton chi' tz'aj yochkan yopisio heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Slajwi chi', tzik'anb'at nok' kelem wakax t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, yik wach' syak'k'e sk'ab' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a sjolom nok'.
Ha t'a yichanh mantiado chi' tza milcham nok' t'a wichanh.
Tzik'ank'eta jab'ok schiq'uil nok' yet' yiximal a k'ab', tza sukanoch t'a sch'ak altar ayk'e t'a schikintak, haxo masanil chik' skan chi', tza tob'kanek' t'a yichtak altar chi'.
Haxo masanil xepu' ayoch t'a sch'anhtza' nok' yet' t'a yib'anh seyub' nok' yet' pax t'a stut nok', tz'ik'eli tza nhusantz'a t'a yib'anh altar.
Haxo nok' chib'ej chi' yet' stz'umal nok', stza' nok', masanil juntzanh chi' tza nhustz'a t'a spatikel campamento, yujto a jun nok' chi' silab' yaj yik tz'ak'ji tup mul.
Slajwi chi', tzik'ankot junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, syak'ank'e sk'ab' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal chi' t'a sjolom nok'.
Tza milancham nok', tza tzikanoch schiq'uil nok' t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.
Slajwi chi', tza kotak xikanb'at nok', smaxchajel nok' yol sk'ool, nok' yok, junnhej tz'aj yet' nok' kotak xikab'il chi' yet' pax nok' sjolom.
Tza nhusantz'a nok' silab'il t'a yib'anh altar t'a wichanh yuj wik'jichaanh, haton jun silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil, sumumi sjab' swab'i.
Slajwi chi', tzik'ankot junxo nok' kalnel, syak'ank'e sk'ab' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a sjolom nok',

tza milancham nok'. Tzik'ank'e jab'ok schiq'uil nok', tza sukanek' t'a sjayil schikin winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal. Haton t'a schikin heb' t'a swach'. Tza sukpaxek' jab'ok t'a smam sk'ab' heb' yet' t'a smam yok heb' t'a swach'. Slajwi chi' tza tzikankanem masanil schiq'uil nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' t'a spatiktak altar chi'.

Haxo schiq'uil nok' kalnel ayoch t'a yib'anh altar chi' tzik'k'e jab'ok, tza tzikanb'at t'a yib'anh winhaj Aarón yet' t'a spichul winh yet' t'a yib'anh heb' yuninal winh yet' pax t'a spatiktak spichul heb'. Icha pax chi' tz'utaj aceite sk'anchaji yik sik'chaj junok mach tz'ochkan wikok. Icha wal chi' tz'aj sik'chajkanel winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal yet' spichul heb'.

Slajwi chi', tzik'anel xepu' ayoch t'a snhe nok' ch'ak kalnel chi', t'a nok' sch'anhtza' yet' t'a yib'anh seyub' nok', tzik'anpaxkot chab' nok' stut yet' pax xepu' ayoch t'ay yet' pax nok' sb'ak'chil xub' t'a swach' yujto a jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi', haton nok' sk'anchaji yik tz'ochkan heb' sacerdote t'a yopisio.
Tzik'anpaxk'eta ixim pan malaj yich, haton ixim ayem t'a yol mooch t'a wichanh, junok ixim pan setan setan yaji, junok ixim kalab'il yet' aceite yet' junok ixim k'oxox.
Masanil juntzanh chi' tzak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal, sb'akhchajoch t'a wichanh.

Slajwi chi', tzik'anek' t'a yol sk'ab' heb', tza nhusantz'a t'a yib'anh altar chi'. Junnhej tz'aj stz'a yet' nok' ch'ak kalnel wan stz'a silab'il, sumumi sjab' swab'i. Snhusjitz'a jun ofrenda chi' yuj wik'jichaanh.
Ha nok' ch'ak kalnel sk'anchaji ayik tz'och winhaj Aarón t'a yopisio, tzik'kanel snhi' sk'ol nok'. Tza b'akhank'e t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik, yujto ik tz'ajkan jun makan nok' chib'ej chi'.
Tza pojanel nok' snhi' sk'ol yet' nok' xub' ix a b'akhk'e t'a wichanh, haton yik nok' ix och yopisio ayik ix ochkan winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a sacerdoteal.
Ha chab' makan nok' chib'ej chi', yik winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal tz'ajkani, haton ofrenda syak' heb' eyetisraelal. Haton chab' makan nok' chi' syak' heb' t'ayin yofrendaok yik junk'olal.

Ha spichul winhaj Aarón syak'och t'a yopisio, skannhej t'a heb' yinhtilal winh. Ha junok yinhtilal winh skan t'a yopisio, ayik tz'och t'a yol mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, yuj in yak'an serwil t'a yol jun lugar Ha Innhej Ay Wiko', anhej juntzanh pichul chi' syak'och heb' t'a uke' k'ual ayik tz'ochkan heb' sacerdoteal.
Tzik'anpaxb'at nok' kalnel ix b'inaji yik tz'ochkan yopisio heb'. Ha t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilpaxeli, hata' tza tz'anh nok'.
Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal schi'an nok' chib'ej chi', swaanpax juntzanh ixim pan ayem t'a yol jun yune' mooch chi' t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.

Haton heb' schi'an nok' ix ak'ji yik tz'ak'ji tup schukal heb', haton yik ix sik'chajel heb' yet' schaankan yopisio heb' t'a sacerdoteal, palta malaj junok ch'ok animail syal schi'an juntzanh chi', yujto wik yaji.
Tato ayto nok' chib'ej chi' yet' ixim pan chi' skan t'a jun k'u chi', tza nhuskantz'aok. Malaj junokxo mach syal schi'ani ma swaani, yujto wik yaji.
Masanil juntzanh tik tza b'o t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal icha wal tz'aj walan t'ayach tik. Uke' k'ual syik' yuj ak'ankanoch yopisio heb' chi'.
Junjun nok' kelem wakax tzak' silab'il t'a junjun k'u, yik tz'ak'ji lajwok smul heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj a sakb'itan altar t'a wichanh, tza sukanpaxoch aceite t'a yib'anh yik tz'ochkan yopisio.

Uke' k'ual tzak' silab' t'a yib'anh altar chi', yik tz'ak'ji lajwok mul. Icha wal chi' tz'aj yochkan jun altar chi' wikok, tz'och t'a yopisio. Yalnhej tastak tz'och tennaj t'a jun altar chi', wikxo tz'ajkani.
Junjun k'u yowalil snhusji chawanh nok' kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal silab'il t'a yib'anh altar.
Jun nok' tza nhustz'a t'a q'uinhib'alil, junxo nok' tza nhustz'a t'a yemk'ualil.
Tzak' chanheok libra harina te wach' yet' nok' stz'a t'a q'uinhib'alil chi', tza kalej ixim harina chi' yet' junok litro aceite yik sat te' olivo, tza sekanem junok litro wino ofrendail.
Hanheja' icha chi' tzutejpax junxo nok' kalnel chi' t'a yemk'ualil, ixim harina yet' wino ofrendail. Ha juntzanh ofrenda snhusjitz'a chi', te sumumi sjab' swab'i.
Ha juntzanh silab' chi', ol snhusnhejtz'a heb' t'a wichanh t'a masanil tiempo t'a stojolal sti' mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, ayik tzin lolon heyet'ok.
Hata' ol in ch'ox in b'a t'a heb' etisraelal, yuj chi' wik ol ajkan jun mantiado chi', yuj in tzikikial.
Ha in wal tzin sik'kanoch jun mantiado chi' wikok yet' yaltaril. Tzin sik'paxkanel winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal chi' yik tz'ochkan heb' sacerdoteal t'ayin.
Ol in kajnaj t'a skal heb' etisraelal, yujto he Diosal in.
Icha wal chi' ol aj snachajel yuj heb' to a in ton Jehová in sDiosal in heb' het'ok, a in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto yik tzin kajnaj t'a he kal, a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, xchi Jehová.
